scripts.dev: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @aka/shared build && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names shared,api,web "pnpm --filter @aka/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @aka/api dev" "pnpm --filter @aka/web dev"
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check apps packages scripts compose*.yaml package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts compose*.yaml package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @aka/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @aka/shared build && pnpm -r --if-present test
